extracted.intended_audience: poets and creative writers (authors of lyric/short poems)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for composing short lyric poems that achieve a single, unified poetic effect (Poe's method for constructing 'The Raven'): choosing effect, tone, length, refrain, metre, locale, and suggestiveness deliberately and procedurally. Emphasizes beginning from the denouement and subordinating all elements to a single aim.

rubrics_metrics.name: Elaborate to denouement first
rubrics_metrics.description: Every plot (or composition) worth the name must be elaborated to its denouement before anything be attempted with the pen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan the ending (climax/denouement) in advance so that incidents, tone, and all parts tend to develop that intention; begin composition at the end where the work should begin to ensure graduated preceding material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commence with a chosen effect
rubrics_metrics.description: Commence with the consideration of an effect: select, first, a novel and secondly a vivid effect to be produced in the reader.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decide whether the chosen effect will be wrought primarily by incident or by tone (or both), and then seek combinations of event and tone to best construct that effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of impression (single-sitting limit)
rubrics_metrics.description: If any literary work is too long to be read at one sitting, it loses the immensely important effect derivable from unity of impression.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For poems especially, observe a strict length limit (Poe chose about one hundred lines) so the poem retains totality/unity; brevity should be in direct ratio to intensity of intended effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beauty as the province of the poem
rubrics_metrics.description: Beauty (the intense and pure elevation of the soul) is the sole legitimate province of the poem.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subordinate truth and passion to beauty when necessary; use truth or passion only to elucidate or aid the predominant aim, toning them into subservience and, where possible, veiling them in Beauty.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select an appropriate tone (melancholy)
rubrics_metrics.description: The tone of the highest manifestation of Beauty is one of sadness; melancholy is the most legitimate of all the poetical tones.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose a tone that most readily produces the intended elevation — Poe argues melancholy most reliably does so for lyric poetic effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality must be deliberately sought
rubrics_metrics.description: Originality is not mere impulse or intuition; to be found it must be elaborately sought, and often consists more in negation than invention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strive for novel combinations (meter, stanza, rhyme, alliteration) rather than relying on stereotyped forms; originality can be achieved by recombining familiar elements in new ways.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use a keynote or refrain and diversify its application
rubrics_metrics.description: Employ a refrain as a keynote; adhere generally to the monotone of sound while continually varying that of thought — produce novel effects by varying the application of the refrain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make the refrain brief (ideally a single word) to facilitate varied application; keep the refrain itself often unchanged while altering its meaning in successive contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Choose a sonorous refrain suited to tone
rubrics_metrics.description: The refrain, to have force, must be sonorous and susceptible of protracted emphasis; certain vowel/consonant combinations (long 'o' with 'r') are especially effective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select a word that embodies the needed sound and matches the predetermined tone (Poe chose 'Nevermore' for melancholy and sonority).

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide a plausible mechanism for repetition
rubrics_metrics.description: If a word is to be continuously repeated, reconcile its repetition with plausibility by selecting an agent whose speech need not be logically reasoning (e.g., a bird).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose a non-reasoning creature or other mechanism compatible with repeated utterance so the repetition does not strain credulity; the agent should also fit the poem's tone (a Raven fit melancholy).

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish the climactic query/answer first
rubrics_metrics.description: Determine the climax or concluding query—the one to which the refrain's final application will give the utmost sorrow—before composing the rest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compose the climactic stanza early to settle rhythm, metre, stanza length, and to ensure preceding stanzas are graduated so none surpass the climactic effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Set rhythm, metre, and stanza form to serve effect
rubrics_metrics.description: Decide meter, stanza form, and rhythm deliberately (Poe details trochaic octameter alternating patterns) and arrange stanzas so their rhythmic effect peaks at the climax.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use versification choices as tools for effect; combine known line-types in original stanza structures and employ rhyme/alliteration to augment the chosen tone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Constrain locale for concentrated attention
rubrics_metrics.description: A close circumscription of space is absolutely necessary to the effect of insulated incident; it acts as a frame to concentrate attention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place the action in a confined setting (e.g., a chamber) rendered meaningful by memories or details that support the poem's Beauty and tone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use contrast to deepen impression
rubrics_metrics.description: Employ contrasts (tempo, imagery, material) to heighten the ultimate impression—for example, stormy night vs interior serenity, marble bust vs live plumage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Introduce contrasts strategically (entry of a fantastic element, shifts from ludicrous to serious) to modulate reader response and deepen emotional impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pace escalation of queries to produce climax
rubrics_metrics.description: Model the protagonist's questions so they progress from commonplace to increasingly important and despairing queries, culminating in the climactic demand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exploit the human tendency toward self-torture and superstition: let the lover's interrogations be successively more serious to extract maximal sorrow from the refrain's answers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduce suggestiveness and undercurrent of meaning
rubrics_metrics.description: Add complexity/adaptation and an under-current of meaning (suggestiveness) so that a richness of implied meaning pervades the narrative without being made explicit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid rendering suggested meaning overt; allow emblematic sense to emerge gradually (e.g., Raven as emblem of 'Mournful and never-ending Remembrance').

rubrics_metrics.name: Subordinate all elements to the predominant aim
rubrics_metrics.description: Objects such as Truth or Passion may be introduced, but a true artist will tone them into proper subservience to the predominant aim (Beauty).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Every device (tone, incident, rhetoric) should serve the central effect; weaken or alter parts if they threaten to compete with the climactic stanza's effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use rhetorical and sound devices intentionally
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply rhyme, alliteration, sonorous words, and stanzaic arrangement to support the effect; choose words (like 'Pallas') for sonorousness and associative fit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Employ these devices to shape mood and emphasis, not as ornament alone; ensure they reinforce the unity and tone of the work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delay and prolong curiosity by careful incident construction
rubrics_metrics.description: Prolong the reader's curiosity (e.g., confuse a tapping at the shutter with a knock at the door) to increase engagement and suspense.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use small misperceptions and gradual reveal to extend attention and prepare the reader for the poem's escalating seriousness.
